input.summary:
P7 west kitchen furnished in parts/room-39.mjs: lit furnace stove in front of the hearth (87,3,15), a one-cell spruce table with a standing lantern (86,3..5,15), and a hanging lantern over the door lane (86,6,14). The lane cells (86,3,14), (87,3,14) and the window/door cells stay clear.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; room-39 reports 5 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
In a scratch copy with stand-in floor, walls and ceiling, `mcd room` says OK: all 3 reachable floor cells lit at 12+, no dark cells. The real build still has Shell B at 0 placed, so the real walk verdict is not yet measurable.

waste.what: Verifying the room's walk and light needed a scratch copy: I wrote /tmp/part46-check/scratch.mjs to lay a jungle_planks floor at y2 and y7, brick walls, the door cell and a campfire, then ran `mcd room` on that copy with a rooms file whose entrance is moved to (86,3,11).
